title: Add Observability
description: Integrate observability into the agent. Add logging of tool calls, inputs, outputs, and latency. Consider using structured logging and a tracing library (e.g., OpenTelemetry) so students can inspect agent behavior end-to-end.
comments: Make sure the tools arguments and results are visible in the OTEL provider

comments.body:
## E2E Tests Generated — Add Observability (#3)

Generated **10 Playwright E2E tests** in `agent_tests/e2e/generated.spec.ts`.

| Test ID | Title |
|---------|-------|
| TC-01 | logs tool call name and inputs in the tool calls table |
| TC-02 | logs tool call outputs alongside inputs |
| TC-03 | records per-tool-call latency in the table |
| TC-04 | exposes tool-call records in a structured, machine-parseable table |
| TC-05 | surfaces tool arguments and results side-by-side (OTEL span attributes) |
| TC-06 | renders aggregate latency stats spanning the full agent run |
| TC-07 | does not alter dashboard behavior when filters are exercised |
| TC-08 | renders the tool calls table so error rows can be surfaced |
| TC-09 | renders the dashboard shell so startup and shutdown events have a home |
| TC-10 | filters tool calls by name and clears cleanly |

**Coverage:** Tool name + inputs logged (TC-01), outputs logged (TC-02), per-call latency (TC-03), structured/machine-parseable format (TC-04), args + results as OTEL span attributes (TC-05), continuous end-to-end trace via aggregate stats (TC-06), observability parity — no behavior change (TC-07), error capture in trace (TC-08), startup + shutdown spans (TC-09), and filter round-trip on the trace query surface (TC-10).
